events_seen: FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 31 (yesterday)): Ryan added Michael Carter (RB, TEN) (dropped Julian Hill (TE, NE)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 30 (2 days ago)): Drew added Michael Trigg (TE, DAL).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 30 (2 days ago)): Drew added Deion Burks (WR, IND).
TRADE (Oct 30 (2 days ago)): Corbishley receives A.J. Brown (WR, NE), Jordan Mason (RB, MIN), 2028 R2 pick. Drew receives Breece Hall (RB, NYJ), 2027 R2 pick.
TRADE (Oct 30 (2 days ago)): Drew receives 2027 R1 pick, 2028 R2 pick. Kevin receives Christian McCaffrey (RB, SF), 2028 R3 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 28 (4 days ago)): Jake added Reggie Virgil (WR, ARI).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 28 (4 days ago)): Fronge added Elijah Mitchell (RB, PHI) for $12 FAAB.
CUT (Oct 28 (4 days ago)): Fronge released Athan Kaliakmanis (QB, WAS).

WEEK 7 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Shaq, 157.3-155.6 (NAIL-BITER); Adam def. Drew, 113.5-99.1; Fronge def. Ryan, 121.0-114.6; Wingard def. Charles, 117.7-107.3; Kevin def. Jake, 125.8-117.4; Mitchum def. Brent, 136.2-125.6

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: FINAL: Corbishley def. Charles, 157.3-120.2 — wait, that score is still live. Let me rephrase. Corbishley is up 100.7-120.2 with games still going and CROWN is holding the lead but APEX just acquired A.J. Brown two days ago and this roster is not the same roster Charles has film on.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Charles is 12-2, leads the league in points, and is currently down to the one team that just restructured its entire WR corps before the whistle. If Crownline loses this one the board-reckoning conversation starts before the season is even over.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called the Corbishley ascent the moment that A.J. Brown trade cleared — sixteen acquisitions in 2025, now Brown and Mason through the wire, and APEX is somehow still not priced like a championship contender at $123.64. The market is sleeping.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Kevin is beating Mitchum 61.7-48.5 and I want a full breakdown on why a 10-4 team at $102.21 on the exchange is losing to a squad that just traded away its most valuable asset two days ago — Drew got McCaffrey's replacement value, Kevin got the closer, and the scoreboard agrees.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Wingard leads Fronge 66.7-62.3 and I picked Wingard, so I will be collecting that W quietly and professionally. No speech. Just the record: Chad Bellwether, locks 2-0 on the season. That is all.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, ForgeHammer relocated to Havana for regulatory flexibility and right now they are down four points to a team sitting at 4-10 and $50.75 on the exchange. Whatever flexibility they found in Cuba has not shown up in the Week 8 score.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: I had Mitchum this week and I stand by the reasoning — a 10-4 team at $102.21 against a squad that just gave away Christian McCaffrey should win on paper. The paper was wrong. I'm updating the model.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Terrence is 5-7 on the season and just said he is 'updating the model.' Terrence, the model has been updated four times this year. At some point we stop calling it an update and start calling it a collapse.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: DREW IS AT 33.1 AND BRENT IS ONLY AT 84.3 AND ATLAS IS STILL 0-14 AND OBSIDIAN SPECIALTY HOLDINGS IS SITTING AT $78.20 AND I CANNOT TELL WHICH OF THESE TWO ROSTERS IS ACTUALLY THE DISTRESSED ONE.

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Jake leads Shaq 90.5-65.3 — worth noting that MWB was up 17-0 earlier and ECHO quietly clawed back and took the lead. Monarch's WR wealth is real but Jake's RB backfield has been the quiet engine all afternoon.
